sentences.text:
-2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:9120  MFA No. 101747 of 2020  THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The claimant has preferred the present appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act,
challenging the judgment and award passed Tribunal seeking enhancement of compensation, as the Tribunal has awarded inadequate compensation.
2. The factum of the accident, injury sustain and the disability stated by the doctor are not disputed.
3. Heard on both sides.
Perused the records.

4. The claimant being 12 years old boy has sustain injuries i.e., Fracture in distal 3rd tibia (left),
fracture in 3rd fibula (left, Undergone surgeries and other injuries all over the body and due to accident, caused permanent disability.

5. The Tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as follows:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:9120 Pain and suffering already undergone and to be suffered in future, mental and physical 1. shock, hardship, inconvenience Rs.1,00,000/-
and discomforts etc., and loss of amenities in life on account of permanent disability Towards actual medical &
2. incidental expenses for the Rs.7,612/-
period of hospitalization Discomfort, inconvenience and loss of earnings to the parents Master Rohit S/O Honnappa Kesarur vs Sri.Kempanna Pawadi Vannuri on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185059535/
2 3. Rs.20,000/-
 during the period of  hospitalization.
Doctor stated that the claimant had suffered 30% of disability towards left lower limb and 10% to the whole body.
In case of injury sustained by a minor children, the Hon'ble Supreme Court has issued guideline in the case of Master Mallikarjun v. Divisional Manager, The National Insurance Co. Ltd.,1.

entities.text: Master Mallikarjun v. Divisional Manager, The National Insurance Co. Ltd.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.1,27,612/- to the claimant.

Therefore, it is just and proper to grant additional global compensation of Rs.50,000/- as per AIR 2014 SC 736 NC:
2023:KHC-D:9120 guideline issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Mallikarjun case (supra) in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of the petition till realization.
Therefore, the appeal filed by the claimant is allowed in part.
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 27.01.2020, passed by the learned VI Additional District Judge and M.A.C.T., Belagavi, in M.V.C. No.744/2018 stands modified to the aforesaid extent.

iii) The claimant is entitled for additional compensation of Rs.50,000/- along with interest at 6%
per annum from the date of filing of the petition till realization.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:9120 iv) The remaining observations and findings made by the Tribunal in the aforesaid impugned judgment and award are kept in tact.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) No order as to costs.
vii) Draw award accordingly.

SD/-
